_comment: Copy this file to config.json (which git ignores) and fill in your paths. Used only by export.py on your PC.
_depth_comment: Folder depth (1-based) used to infer publisher and bundle from your library path when those attributes are not set in Orynt3D. Count from the library root: root=1, next folder=2, etc. Set to 0 to disable path-derived fallback for that field.
_entry_limit_comment: Max models to process. Set to 0 for all. Use 20-50 for test runs, but do not publish a test run. IMPORTANT: Always close Orynt3D before exporting.
_test_images_comment: true = full export, but every model shows a shared SAMPLE image (real image found) or MISSING IMAGE stand-in instead of its own thumbnail. Only two images are written. Use for checking the pipeline without a large upload.
_thumb_comment: WebP thumbnails. RGBA preserved. Quality 80-85 recommended. thumb_encode_method: 0=fastest, 6=best compression.
_exclude_comment: Models belonging to any of these Orynt3D collection names are skipped entirely.
_demo_comment: When non-empty, only models from these publisher names are included. Empty list = include all.
_send_url_comment: Optional. POST endpoint for the Send button in the viewer. Leave empty to disable.
